title: Weave a Title
narrative: The gate answers only to a traveller named properly. Take the first name from a full name, and weave it into a title fit for the door.
instructions:
Write a function `title_card(full_name, rank)`.

- Take the FIRST word of `full_name`.
- Weave it into this exact sentence: `<first> the <rank>`

For example, `title_card("Kael Ash", "Brave")` returns `"Kael the Brave"`.
starting_code:
def title_card(full_name, rank):
    # Take the first word of full_name, then weave: <first> the <rank>
    # e.g. title_card("Kael Ash", "Brave") -> "Kael the Brave"
    return None
hints: Split the full name into words with `full_name.split()`.
Weave it with an f-string: `f"{full_name.split()[0]} the {rank}"`.
A name with only one word splits into a one-item list, so [0] still gives that single name.
